# Module M-07: Recognise an order from an unknown customer

## Lesson

You do this when a new customer orders for the first time. When it works, no invoice is made and the order is on the exceptions list. [SC-07]

## Exercise

In the test environment, with its test data:

1. Look for the order from the new customer. [SC-07 step 1]
2. Check the exceptions list and the invoices: there is no invoice for it. [SC-07 step 2]

## Check question

What do you do when it goes wrong?

## Answer

Add the customer in QuickBooks Online first, then settle the line. [map/future.md item 4]
